title: Playbook: lead advisors and the office
purpose: Middle rank: what the lead advisors and the office manager can do beyond an advisor.
facts: Middle rank: history window 365 days against 180 for junior; customer contact details in lists; conversation statistics by period and operator; can propose knowledge changes (product defaults).
Slot 3 reads pay and till counts (design 7.2: the ERP rule opens them from middle).
Lead duties: price check, page check within five working days, hard calls handed up with a card, no approval of discounts over 10 %.
Example: "Draft a correction to the timing belt page" is what slot 5 did at T-8 days (S12).
Colleagues' call scores are a senior view.

list_items.section: What you have beyond an advisor
list_items.item: A year of history instead of six months.

list_items.section: What you have beyond an advisor
list_items.item: Customers' contact details in lists, when you need them for statements or call backs.

list_items.section: What you have beyond an advisor
list_items.item: Conversation numbers for the period and by person.

list_items.section: What you have beyond an advisor
list_items.item: You can propose a change to a knowledge page. Greg, Dale, Ray or Claire decides it.

list_items.section: What you have beyond an advisor
list_items.item: Donna also reads pay and the till counts, because the books need them.

list_items.section: What we expect of a lead
list_items.item: You are the price check. A newcomer's estimate does not go out unread.

list_items.section: What we expect of a lead
list_items.item: You are the page check. When a price or a rule changes, the service pages you keep are right within five working days. If you find a wrong page, propose the fix that day and say why in the proposal.

list_items.section: What we expect of a lead
list_items.item: You take the hard call and hand it up with a card when it needs money to fix.

list_items.section: What we expect of a lead
list_items.item: You do not approve discounts over 10 %. You ask.
"Which service pages still show the old labour rate?"
"Draft a correction to the timing belt page." It shows you the exact change on a card. You confirm; it goes to the deciders.
"Which estimates have been waiting more than a day?"
"Whose calls should a new advisor listen to?" It will say that scores across colleagues are a manager's view, and it is right.
Publish a page change for you, or approve your own proposal.

notes_for_russian_writer: Same playbook for the same rank; examples from the Russian stories and channels. The product pins the playbooks folder at administrator in both configurations.
